svg.aria-label: Bethanechol, page 2 of 2. Contraindication Hypersensitivity; hyperthyroidism; peptic ulcer; latent or active asthma; pronounced bradycardia or hypotension; vasomotor instability; coronary artery disease; epilepsy or parkinsonism. Do not use with mechanical GI/urinary obstruction or when contraction may harm recent surgery or a weakened wall; consult the product label for the complete exclusions. Adverse reaction Bronchospasm, marked bradycardia or hypotension; cholinergic toxicity. Side effects Abdominal cramps, diarrhea, salivation, sweating, flushing, nausea. Special notes Take on an empty stomach. Confirm retention is not due to obstruction.
